mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transfer_task (task_id, status, status_desc, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{status}, #{statusDesc}, NOW(), NOW())
INSERT INTO transfer_task_detail (task_id, step, message, success, created_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{step}, #{message}, #{success}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, step, message, success, created_at FROM transfer_task_detail WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY id ASC
